title: Reading Drill — Changing the Doors of a Station Shelter
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Changing the Doors of a Station Shelter
passages.body:
**A** A station shelter admitted wind through two openings facing each other. An observer used paper tags on the frame to see where air moved fastest.

**B** The team added a transparent panel at an angle beside one door. Because people could look through it, the panel kept the route visible while blocking a direct draught.

**C** The shelter was tested during two cold mornings. On the second day a worker stood outside to count boarding passengers, checking whether the change affected their movement.

questions.prompt: An observer used ______ on the frame to see where air moved fastest.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: An observer used paper tags on the frame to see where air moved fastest.

questions.prompt: Because people could look through it, the panel kept the route ______ while blocking a direct draught.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: Because people could look through it, the panel kept the route visible while blocking a direct draught.

questions.prompt: On the second day a worker stood outside to count ______, checking whether the change affected their movement.
questions.instructions: Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the passage.
questions.explanation: On the second day a worker stood outside to count boarding passengers, checking whether the change affected their movement.
